# AMD FSR artwork

These two transparent white lockups are the original files supplied by AMD's
[FSR naming and branding guidelines](https://gpuopen.com/amd-fsr-naming-guidelines/).
Their SHA-256 values and download URLs are recorded in
`docs/branding/graphics-sdk-assets.json`. The artwork retains AMD's trademark
rights and is not licensed under the game's Apache-2.0 license.
